title: The Ra channelings and the Law of One

tellings.quote: through the raw channelings that Bharich was involved in with Carla Rukert who published the raw material and the law of one.

plain: In the 1980s, a woman named Carla Rueckert and a partner the parapsychologist Jeffrey Mishlove calls Bharich held sessions in which messages said to come from a being called Ra were channeled, meaning spoken through a person in a trance. Mishlove tells Michels that Rueckert published these messages as The Ra Material and The Law of One. He brings them up as a source of teachings that some take as contact with a non-human intelligence.
